requirements.summary: Fix the jsPDF library initialization failure that prevents PDF generation for all products
acceptanceCriteria: The jsPDF library loads successfully without throwing initialization errors
PDF generation completes for all three default products
No 'PDF library failed to load' error appears when generating PDFs

file_operations.description: Fix the jsPDF global reference to use window.jsPDF (capital P) instead of window.jspdf.jsPDF, matching how the CDN exposes the library in frontend/index.html. Update getJsPDF() to check for window.jsPDF directly and createDocument() to use the corrected reference.

Ensure the library availability check uses the corrected jsPDF reference. Verify that error handling properly surfaces library loading failures with the 'PDF library failed to load' message when getJsPDF() returns null.

requirements.summary: Ensure the PDF generation flow properly handles library loading errors and provides clear feedback if the library fails to initialize
acceptanceCriteria: If jsPDF fails to load, the error message clearly indicates a library loading problem
The generation process does not attempt to create PDFs if the library is unavailable
Users receive actionable feedback when library initialization fails

file_operations.description: Enhance the error formatting logic to explicitly check for 'PDF library failed to load' error messages and provide clear, actionable feedback such as 'The PDF library failed to initialize. Please refresh the page and try again.' Include troubleshooting guidance for library loading failures.

Add explicit validation that the PDF library is available before attempting PDF generation. If the library check fails, throw a GenerationError with step 'library-check' and a descriptive message. Ensure the error propagates properly to the UI layer without attempting to proceed with PDF creation.
